item.title: As Supreme Court stays UGC Regulations of 2026, read about the 2012 Rules that are currently in force and the key differences between them
item.description: The 2012 regulations did not limit the definition of discrimination to select caste groups only. However, the 2026 UGC guidelines explicitly left out General Category students. 'Caste-based discrimination' in the new regulation was defined as discrimination only on the basis of caste or tribe against the members of the scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, and other backward classes.
